# `google.status`

Content-free combined Drive + Gmail freshness snapshot: aggregates the local drive.status and gmail.status snapshots into one stale/fresh verdict and dashboard line. Still no OVT-side Google calls — reads only persisted import state already on disk. CLI-only: pass --brief for one plain-text line suited to a session-start hook instead of full JSON.

- **group:** `read`
- **posture:** `safe`
- **CLI:** `operator-voice google-status`
- **MCP tool:** `google_status`

## Examples

```
operator-voice google-status
```
```
operator-voice google-status --brief
```

## Errors

| code | what it means |
|---|---|
| `invalid_arguments` | An argument was missing, had the wrong type, or wasn't one of the allowed choices — nothing changed. |
